title: WCAG
content: # WCAG Non-text Content 1.1.1 (Understanding 1.1.1) Tutorial Images User Story Describes the value of text alternatives to a blind user Provide visible controls to allow users to stop any animations or auto-playing sound. This applies to carousels, image sliders, background sound, and videos. Provide controls for content that starts automatically SHARE -- 12 of 13 -- 4/2/2018 Tips on Designing for Web Accessibility • Tips for Getting Started • WAI https://www.w3.org/WAI/gettingstarted/tips/designing.html 13/13 Example: Show play/stop and selection controls in carousel design For more information
